overall_goal: Prepare, wash, and slice the spring greens

goals.description: Retrieve spring greens from the fridge and bag
goals.rationale: The person closes the fridge and takes a bunch of spring greens out of the bag to prepare for cooking.

goals.description: Pluck and sort spring green leaves
goals.rationale: The person plucks individual leaves from the bunch, inspecting them and discarding any that have brown spots or holes.

goals.description: Weigh the selected spring green leaves
goals.rationale: The person uses a kitchen scale to weigh the plucked leaves, adding more until the desired amount is reached.

goals.description: Wash and dry the spring green leaves
goals.rationale: The person washes the leaves under running water and squeezes them to remove excess moisture.

goals.description: Prepare the chopping board and slice the spring greens
goals.rationale: The person clears the chopping board of peels, grabs a knife, and slices the washed spring greens into strips.
